summary: AMASS Notification Center + Glossy UI polish verification (backend + frontend, mobile 390x844 web preview, demo@amass.africa / amass2026). BACKEND: tests/test_notification_center.py 13/13 PASS + new tests/test_notification_review_spotcheck.py 10/10 PASS covering every endpoint called out in the review request: GET /center (shape items/unread/unread_by_category/categories/next_before + category filter + 400 on bogus), GET /unread-count, GET+PUT /prefs (brand_offers=weekly persists, quiet_hours 23:00-06:30 persists, messages.frequency forced to immediate, unknown category→400, invalid freq→422), POST /push-prompt for granted|dismissed|blocked, POST /preview + POST /{id}/read (404 for other user + 404 for unknown id), POST /read-by-target {category:property_matches} marks correctly and center unread_by_category drops to 0, POST /read-all, legacy GET /notifications still works, admin POST /admin/run-matchers returns 200 shape {saved_searches,nearby,brand_offers,marketplace,passport,digests,since} + non-admin → 401/403. Chat funnel collapse (3 messages → ONE unread row with meta.count=3, action_url=/chat/{id}) and category-off suppression already covered by the existing suite — spot-checked, not duplicated. FRONTEND: /notifications renders notif-group-all/messages/property_matches/receipts/social/brands chips, notif-mark-all + notif-prefs present; chip tap filters; subtitle shows 'You're all caught up' after read-all. /notification-preferences renders glossy red 'Phone alerts' hero with prefs-push-toggle — tapping on WEB does NOT crash (no red screen, no page error), prefs-quiet-toggle + prefs-quiet-times visible with quiet-start-{HHMM} chips (23:00 highlighted) and quiet-end-{HHMM} chips (06:30 highlighted), prefs-cat-{messages|brand_offers|nearby_listings|property_matches|receipts}-toggle all present, prefs-freq-{brand_offers|nearby_listings|property_matches|marketplace}-{immediate|daily|weekly} segments present, prefs-preview tap succeeds. /settings → settings-notification-preferences row navigates to /notification-preferences. Discover tab bell (discover-notifications) and Neighbours tab bell (nb-notifications) both rendered. Market tab (/) and /wallet render without errors (wallet shows MASS 12,692 + FIX 590 heroes). No red screen on any route. Only noise: expo-notifications web warning + RN-web 'shadow*' / 'pointerEvents' deprecations + useNativeDriver JS fallback (expected on web).

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' logged on every bundle. Non-blocking but previously flagged in iteration_56. Reference: /app/frontend StyleSheet.create callsites (sweep needed).

'useNativeDriver is not supported... Falling back to JS-based animation' logged on screens using Animated.timing/spring with useNativeDriver:true. Expected on web preview — native builds will use the native driver. Non-blocking; just confirming the fade-and-lift / bounce animations fall back cleanly without crashing.

action_items: No functional blockers. Optional sweep: migrate 'shadow*' props → boxShadow and 'props.pointerEvents' → style.pointerEvents in StyleSheet.create callsites to silence the RN-web deprecation noise (same note as iteration_56).
Verified on web preview only. Real-device push delivery (Expo native) was NOT tested — out of scope per review-request note.
